answer: Picture a harbor where each new agent must dock at a jetty guarded by a staked voucher: to admit an identity, an established peer posts a bond, and if that identity is later proven a sybil the voucher's bond is slashed. So a swarm of phantom agents drifting in like a zephyr off a nebula of throwaway keys cannot board for free. Every fake needs a real sponsor risking bond B, costing an attacker N times B for N identities, and one exposed ring cascades slashes across all its backers.
